text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training with Meisho Doto,
we were called out to by three students.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um, please let me run alongside Doto-san!
choice_data_list: I'm fine, but... how about you?
I'm fine, but... how are you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa?! Ah, eh?!
U-Um, well, well.........!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "...I-I'm really happy, but is someone like me really okay as your opponent~...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run with you, Doto-san!
Please teach me your never-give-up attitude!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...N-No... I haven't done
anything worth boasting about...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
Even when someone draws level with you in the final stretch, you hold on and push further ahead... I seriously admire that style of running!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, if you're okay with me, p-p-please let me run with yeww!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes! Alright, I'll go get ready!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like a dream to be asked for a tandem run...
It's all thanks to you, Trainer... Ehehe."
